incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: realtime-p95-detector triggered for /v1/generate-stream — p95 jumped to 1.9s, p99 to 6.4s, streaming stalls observed. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/latency/realtime (inc:1776543210)
Amanda L: ack, looking. Which region? saw a small rollout ~5m ago.
Raj P (oncall): on it — I'm the pager. Checking deploys and autoscale.
Amanda L: spike correlates with a config push: kv-cache-optimizations:v2 rolled to 30% at 1776543008 per deploy-bot.
Jules: logs show repeated `kv-cache miss`/`cache-evict` on streaming workers + GPU mem pressure on shard-3 (ap-southeast-1). Copy of recent log snippet:```
[1776543025] worker-3: stream_request id=abc123 kv_cache_miss key=conv-42
[1776543027] worker-3: OOM_WARNING gpu0 mem=92%
[1776543030] worker-3: stall detected, client_conn_wait
```
Chao: fwiw, we also saw an uptick in long sequences from a single customer test harness around the same time. Could be sequence distribution causing kv thrash.
Raj P (oncall): quick triage checklist: 1) confirm rollback toggle 2) route heavy streaming traffic away from affected pool 3) scale up streaming workers. I'm going to attempt (1) now.
Amanda L: rollback flag is `FEATURE_KV_PREFIX_CACHE=false` in runtime-config. You can patch via API:```bash
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"runtime_config":{"FEATURE_KV_PREFIX_CACHE":"false"}}' https://ops-api.redwood.example/v1/services/streaming/config
```
Raj P (oncall): patching...
oncall-bot: Deploy patch queued by Raj P — rollout id r-1776543244
Raj P (oncall): rollout applied, forcing restart of streaming pods in ap-southeast-1. Running `kubectl rollout restart deployment/streaming-worker -n prod --context=cluster-ap-sea`
Jules: watching logs. still seeing some stalls but p95 trending down.
Chao: if rollback doesn't stabilize, plan B: temporarily route `/v1/generate-stream` traffic to dedicated-small pool in us-west which has spare capacity. Runbook command (traffic-router):```json
{"route":"/v1/generate-stream","from":"global/primary","to":"dedicated/small","match":{"region":"ap-southeast-1"}}
```
Amanda L: customer impact note: streaming sessions experience intermittent stalls and long tails starting ~1776543000. No dropped outputs observed, just increased latency and occasional reconnects. Initial estimate: ~12 customers with sustained elevated latencies, highest impact on those using unbounded streaming.
Raj P (oncall): p95 back to ~420ms after patch in ap-southeast-1, p99 still ~1.1s but trending down. Rolling restart finished at 1776543389.
Jules: observed correlation: new kv-cache eviction heuristics + longer seq inputs => cache churn, GPU mem spikes, and stalls. Hypothesis: the heuristics are too aggressive for streaming mode.
Amanda L: agree. Next steps: 1) revert kv-cache-optimizations:v2 from canary (owner: infra/serving) 2) run focused repro with long sequences and monitor cache metrics (owner: eng-ml) 3) follow-up postmortem and customer comms (owner: support/product).
Raj P (oncall): I've created an incident ticket INC-177654 in the tracker and pinged support for affected customers. I'm marking this as "mitigated" for paging, leaving issue open for postmortem.
Chao: adding recommended mitigations to runbook: - disable prefix cache by default for streaming endpoints - add guard on cache-evict rate - add alert to detect kv-evict surge sooner.
Amanda L: thanks everyone. If p99 doesn't fully normalize in 30m we'll reopen paging. For now I'll update the status page and draft a short customer note. :white_check_mark:
Raj P (oncall): thanks — handing back to infra/serving for revert and root cause.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated: paging cleared at 1776543490 (duration ~4.5m).
